def equation(eps, T, params):
    P = (1+params[0]*eps)**(params[1]+params[2]*T)
    return (params[3] + params[4]*T + params[5]*T**2)*P + params[6]*eps + params[7]*eps*T + params[8]*T**3 + params[9]

def equation(eps, T, params):
    L = np.log(1+params[0]*eps)
    return (params[1] + params[2]*T + params[3]*T**2 + params[4]*T**3 + (params[5] + params[6]*T + params[7]*T**2)*L
